edit.statement: For B1 only, changing the yield from 10% to 20% raises its stipulated value from $100 to $120.
edit.subject: B1’s 10%-to-20% yield change
edit.original: For B1, a $110 payment in one year has a present value of $100 at a 10% yield; changing the yield to 20% lowers its value to about $91.67.
edit.scope: One stipulated B1 repricing event; fixed payment, maturity and all other inputs. Other bonds retain standard discounting. Do not enforce the unchanged discounting formula on the exceptional edited value.
premises: A bond’s value is its future payment discounted at its yield, so a higher yield lowers its value.
